_about: What each glasses screen shows and says (agent C). Every screen tells the wearer what to say next. 'hint'/'hint2' are on-screen lines (<= 40 chars); 'say' is spoken on entry. {placeholders} are filled at runtime.

home.title: Worn
home.say: Hi! Say learn, write my name, or help.

words.title: {language}
words.say: {language}. Say a word: hello, thank you, water, friend, or one.

watch.after: Your turn. Say next when you're ready.

your_turn.last: Last stroke! Say done when it's on paper.

pass.say: {reaction} Say next for the next word.

language_done.say: You've done every {language} word! Say home, or a new language.

name.title: Write my name
name.say: Say your name, like: my name is Maria.
name.after_name: {name}. Say a language: Hindi, Arabic, Russian, Hebrew, or Greek.
name.shown: That's {name} in {language}. Write it, then say done.

compose.title: Help me write
compose.say: What do you want to write? Say: how do I write good morning in Greek.
compose.shown: {text} in {language}. Write it, then say done.
compose.failed: I couldn't write that one. Try a shorter phrase.
suggestions: how do I write good morning in Greek

daily5.title: Daily 5
daily5.say: Five quick words from memory. Here's the first.
daily5.done: Daily five done! {score} of 5. Say home.
daily5.empty: Learn a few words first. Say learn.

journal.title: Journal
journal.say: Your journal. Say next or previous to flip pages.
journal.empty: Nothing here yet. Say learn to write your first word.

howto.title: How to use
howto.say: Here's how Worn works. Say next for each tip.

pages.title: Just talk
pages.say: Just talk. Say what you want, like learn Greek, home, or back.

pages.title: Watch, then write
lines: Write it on paper, big and dark.
pages.say: Watch each stroke, then write it on paper with a dark pen.

pages.title: Say done
pages.say: Look at your paper and say I'm done. I'll check it.

pages.title: Stuck?
pages.say: Stuck? Say show me again, slower, skip, or what can I say.

pages.title: Button
pages.say: The button is a backup. Press for next, hold to check.

pages.title: Your name
pages.say: Say my name is, then your name, and I'll spell it in a new script.
